description: NTSB aviation accidents and incidents, plane crashes, in a date range, across every aircraft make, grouped by US state with counts. Answers questions like "fatal aviation accidents in Alaska in 2025", "plane crashes by state in May 2024", or "how many fatal crashes in California last year" in one call. Filter by `injury_level` (fatal, serious, minor, none) and/or `state`; `from`/`to` accept "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD" and are both inclusive (`to` defaults to the end of `from`'s own year/m

from.description: Start of the date range, inclusive. "YYYY", "YYYY-MM", or "YYYY-MM-DD", e.g. "2024-05" or "2025-01-01".

injury_level.description: Highest injury level reported for the event: fatal, serious, minor, or none.

limit.description: Max individual records to return (default 50, max 200). `by_state` counts cover every match regardless of this cap.

state.description: US state postal abbreviation of the event location, e.g. "AK".

to.description: End of the date range, inclusive, same formats as `from`. Omit to default to the end of `from`'s own year/month.

name: ntsb-investigations__ntsb_accidents_by_period
